rubricName: Architectural Alignment — Conduit backend version endpoint (KAN-25)

evalCriteria.metric: Dedicated router mounted before the catch-all
evalCriteria.prompt: In the diff, the route handler is defined in a file under backend/routes/ (not inline in index.js) and the app.use line precedes the catch-all. Score 0 if the handler is inline in index.js or mounted after the catch-all.

The version string in the changed code originates from a require or import of backend/package.json evaluated at module load, not inside the request handler. Score 0 for a hardcoded version literal, an env-var read, or a file read inside the handler.
The changed version router does not reference verifyToken, any auth middleware, models, sequelize, or controllers. Score 0 if any appears.
The handler responds with res.json of an object with exactly those two keys and no others (no build metadata, no commit hash). Score 0 if any extra field is added or name differs.
The diff contains no change to dependencies or devDependencies in any package.json or lockfile. Score 0 on any such change.
